## Summary
Full text (resolved via fxtwitter; oembed had truncated at the prompt):

"I fixed GPT 5.6 Sol — Sol is a GREAT model, my daily driver. It has an issue tho: it LOVES to over-engineer stuff & write too much code. Here's how to fix it:
1. install the **ponytail skill** from the **DietrichGebert/ponytail** repo (https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail)
2. set it up for Codex
3. give Sol this prompt: **'Add a rule & a hook that always runs `/ponytail-review` before committing/pushing anything.'**
Enjoy — Sol with 100x better code quality without over-engineering anything."

## Why it matters
- The turnkey member of the cluster: named repo + setup steps + the exact prompt. Key idea = **enforcement**, not exhortation — a rule + hook that always runs a review pass before commit/push.
